parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(s.current_state, 'INFO') AS current_state, s.last_event_time FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy LEFT JOIN afd_states s ON s.source_id = '{{ $json.source_id }}'

INSERT INTO afd_states (source_id, current_state, previous_state, last_symbol, last_event_time, updated_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.source_id }}', '{{ $json.afd_state }}', '{{ $json.previous_state }}', '{{ $json.afd_symbol }}', NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (source_id) DO UPDATE SET current_state = EXCLUDED.current_state, previous_state = EXCLUDED.previous_state, last_symbol = EXCLUDED.last_symbol, last_event_time = EXCLUDED.last_event_time, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
UPDATE logs SET afd_state = '{{ $json.afd_state }}', afd_symbol = '{{ $json.afd_symbol }}', previous_state = '{{ $json.previous_state }}' WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}

SELECT message 
FROM logs WHERE source_id = '{{ $json.source_id }}'
ORDER BY log_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    source_id,
    current_state,
    last_event_time
FROM afd_states
WHERE current_state = 'CRITICAL'
ORDER BY last_event_time DESC;

SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM llm_cache
        WHERE message_hash = '{{ $json.message_hash }}'
    ) AS cache_found,
    (
        SELECT response_text
        FROM llm_cache
        WHERE message_hash = '{{ $json.message_hash }}'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS response_text,
    (
        SELECT llm_source
        FROM llm_cache
        WHERE message_hash = '{{ $json.message_hash }}'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS llm_source,
    (
        SELECT hit_count
        FROM llm_cache
        WHERE message_hash = '{{ $json.message_hash }}'
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS hit_count;

UPDATE llm_cache
SET
    hit_count = hit_count + 1,
    last_hit_at = NOW()
WHERE message_hash = '{{ $json.message_hash }}';

INSERT INTO llm_cache (
    message_hash,
    category,
    afd_state,
    response_text,
    llm_source,
    created_at,
    last_hit_at,
    hit_count
)
VALUES (
    '{{ $json.message_hash }}',
    '{{ $json.category }}',
    '{{ $json.afd_state }}',
    '{{ JSON.stringify({
        cause_probable: $json.cause_probable,
        actions_immediates: $json.actions_immediates,
        escalade_si: $json.escalade_si,
        severite_estimee: $json.severite_estimee
    }).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.llm_source }}',
    NOW(),
    NOW(),
    1
)
ON CONFLICT (message_hash)
DO UPDATE SET
    last_hit_at = NOW(),
    hit_count = llm_cache.hit_count + 1;
